# Result schema

<!-- check: none: generated by scripts/generate_reference.py -->

This page lists the fields of `summary.json` and of the phase profile. It is
generated from the `result_schema` and `phase_profile_schema` fields of
`cfd-craft describe`. What the files mean and which checks `report` repeats
is in the [result contract](../result-contract.md). A field without a default
that is not required may be absent; null means unavailable, not zero.

## Summary

The result of one native run (schema `cfd-craft.result/0.1`), written as summary.json: identities, the stopping reason and numerical verdict, work counters, geometry, the recomputed checks and per-constituent evidence. `termination` says why execution stopped; `assessment` says what the checks support; experimental validation is a separate question. Null means unavailable in the stated context, not zero.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assessment` | `string` | required | Numerical verdict: `steady_discrete_solution` or `transient_interval_completed` (completed with every check passed), `failed_checks` (completed, some check failed) or `incomplete` (any other termination). Never upgraded because the last state looks reasonable. |
| `build_version` | `string` | required | Package version and compiler of the producing build, as `<version>; <rustc version>`. |
| `case_sha256` | `string` | required | SHA-256 of the consumed, normalized case as compact JSON. |
| `checks` | array of [Check](#check) | required | Every recomputed check of the returned state. |
| `constituents` | array of [ScalarEvidence](#scalarevidence) | required | Evidence for each constituent, in case order. |
| `elapsed_s` | `number` | required | Wall seconds of this invocation, from the creation of its control. |
| `error` | `string` or `null` | optional | The failure that stopped the run, usually with its code (for example `CFD-E033: pressure iteration limit 100`), or `cancelled` / `wall_time_limit` when the stop came inside a step; null otherwise. |
| `estimated_peak_mib` | `number` | required | The preflight memory estimate of the case check, in MiB. |
| `experimental_validation` | `string` | required | Always `not_validated; see validation/data-inventory.json`: numerical acceptance is not experimental validation. |
| `fluid_cells` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Number of fluid cells. |
| `fluid_components` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Number of face-connected fluid regions, each with its own pressure gauge unless it touches an outlet. |
| `initial_state_sha256` | `string` | required | SHA-256 of the starting state (cold or restored), so restarts from different states stay distinguishable. |
| `mask_sha256` | `string` | required | SHA-256 of the cell mask, one byte per cell (1 fluid, 0 solid) in cell order; also in geometry.json. |
| `model_scope` | `string` | required | Model label: `incompressible_laminar`, `prescribed_flow_passive_transport` or `neutral_k_epsilon_rough_wall`; the CLI prefixes `preview: ` for a coarsened preview. |
| `momentum_residual` | `number` or `null` | optional | Largest normalized momentum residual, null for prescribed flow. |
| `momentum_solver_iterations` | `integer` or `null` (>= 0) | optional | Inner iterations of implicit momentum-correction solves, when selected. |
| `name` | `string` | required | The case name. |
| `physical_time_s` | `number` | required | Time covered in seconds; pseudo-time in steady mode. |
| `physics_sha256` | `string` | required | Physics hash of the case: the case without `name`, `run` and `output`. Checkpoints are compatible across cases with the same value. |
| `pressure_iterations` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Cumulative pressure PCG iterations of the retained steps. |
| `receptor_relative_change` | `number` or `null` | optional | Largest relative change between the means of three successive monitor windows over all monitor columns (flow norm, constituent masses, receptor values and, with `neutral_rans`, mean k and epsilon); null before three full windows. The `monitor_stability` value of steady runs. |
| `schema_version` | `string` | required | Always `cfd-craft.result/0.1`. |
| `solid_cells` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Number of solid cells. |
| `source_sha256` | `string` | required | Source fingerprint of the producing build. A library run reports the core crate's; the CLI and the Python binding combine it with their own. |
| `steps` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Retained steps (outer iterations with an implicit steady algorithm), cumulative across restarts. |
| `termination` | `string` | required | Why execution stopped: `completed`, `iteration_limit` (step budget), `wall_time_limit`, `cancelled` or `diverged` (a failed step, recorded in `error`). |
| `threads` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | The case's declared `run.threads`, not a measurement of the pool. |
| `turbulence_residual` | `number` or `null` | optional | Largest normalized k or epsilon residual, `neutral_rans` only. |
| `turbulent_floor_events` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Turbulence updates that hit the k or epsilon floor; any event fails the turbulence checks. |
| `velocity_max_m_s` | `number` | required | Largest absolute face velocity in m/s. |

### Check

One numerical check, recomputed by the solver from the current fields. A check passes when its value is finite and at most its threshold. Continuity and residual values are normalized with the case's velocity and length scales (`neutral_rans`: `speed_m_s` and `reference_height_m`; otherwise the reference speed, at least 1 m/s, and the shortest domain side).

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `string` | required | How the value was obtained, for example `application recomputation from current fields`. |
| `name` | `string` | required | What is checked: `local_continuity`, `boundary_volume_balance`, `steady_momentum_equations`, `steady_turbulence_equations`, `turbulence_floor_events`, `monitor_stability`, or per constituent `<id>.mass_budget`, `<id>.negative_mass`, `<id>.steady_equation` and `<id>.steady_mass_balance`. The steady checks appear in steady mode only, the turbulence checks with `neutral_rans` only. |
| `passed` | `boolean` | required | Whether the value is finite and at most the threshold. |
| `threshold` | `number` | required | Largest accepted value, a fixed gate or the tolerance from the case. |
| `value` | `number` or `null` | optional | The measured value, or null when it is not finite or not available, such as `monitor_stability` before three full monitor windows. A null value fails. |

### ScalarEvidence

Evidence for one constituent at the returned state: mass budget, extrema, the steady residual, instantaneous rates and receptor values. Cumulative quantities are in kg, rates in kg/s, concentrations in kg/m3.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boundary_inflow_rate_kg_s` | `number` | required | Current rate of mass entering through boundary faces. |
| `boundary_outflow_rate_kg_s` | `number` | required | Current rate of mass leaving through boundary faces. |
| `budget_defect_kg` | `number` | required | `mass_kg` minus initial, emitted and inflow mass plus outflow mass. |
| `emitted_kg` | `number` | required | Cumulative mass emitted by the sources. |
| `id` | `string` | required | The constituent ID. |
| `inflow_kg` | `number` | required | Cumulative mass that entered through boundary faces. |
| `mass_kg` | `number` | required | Mass in the domain, the sum of concentration times cell volume. |
| `maximum_kg_m3` | `number` | required | Largest concentration over all cells, at least 0. |
| `minimum_kg_m3` | `number` | required | Smallest concentration over the fluid cells. |
| `negative_mass_kg` | `number` | required | Mass of the negative concentrations, as a positive number; never clipped. |
| `outflow_kg` | `number` | required | Cumulative mass that left through boundary faces. |
| `receptors_kg_m3` | object with string keys and values of `number` | required | Concentration at each receptor, keyed by receptor ID. JSON maps are sorted lexically (`R10` before `R2`), so look values up by ID. |
| `relative_budget_defect` | `number` | required | Absolute budget defect over the sum of initial, emitted, inflow and outflow mass; the `mass_budget` check requires at most 1e-9. |
| `source_rate_kg_s` | `number` | required | Emission rate of the represented sources. |
| `steady_residual` | `number` | required | Largest steady-equation residual \|dc/dt\| over the cells, normalized by the velocity scale, the length scale and `maximum_kg_m3`. |

The phase profile is the `timing` field of the `profile.json` that
`cfd-craft profile` writes.

## Profile

A phase profile (schema `cfd-craft.phase-profile/0.1`): wall time and work per solver phase. Only exclusive times may be added. Work includes failed attempts, so it can exceed the counters of the retained state.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accounted_exclusive_s` | `number` | required | Sum of the exclusive seconds of all phases. |
| `elapsed_s` | `number` | required | Wall seconds since the control was created, at the snapshot. |
| `phases` | object with string keys and values of [PhaseTiming](#phasetiming) | required | Timing of each phase that ran, keyed by its snake_case phase name. |
| `schema_version` | `string` | required | Always `cfd-craft.phase-profile/0.1`. |
| `unattributed_s` | `number` | required | Elapsed minus exclusive phases for a single serial invocation. Parallel callers may have aggregate phase time exceeding elapsed wall time. |

### MultigridWork

Attempted work, accumulated locally without timers or locks inside PCG. Hierarchy dimensions/storage are maxima, not sums over repeated solves.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block_level_cell_visits` | `integer` (>= 0) | optional | Cells of the block-smoothed levels per visit; omitted when zero. Then smoothing = 4 x residual - 2 x block visits. |
| `block_smoothing_cell_updates` | `integer` (>= 0) | optional | Cell updates of block sweeps; omitted when zero. Twice the block level visits. |
| `block_solves` | `integer` (>= 0) | optional | Exact line or plane block solves; omitted when zero. |
| `coarse_solves` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Dense direct solves on the coarsest level, one per cycle. |
| `cycles` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | V-cycles applied, one per preconditioner application. |
| `hierarchy_builds` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Hierarchy constructions (0 when a cached hierarchy was reused). |
| `hierarchy_bytes` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Retained hierarchy storage in bytes (maximum over the merged solves). |
| `hierarchy_cells` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Unknowns over all levels (maximum over the merged solves). |
| `hierarchy_levels` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Number of levels (maximum over the merged solves). |
| `hierarchy_nonzeros` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Stored matrix entries over all levels (maximum over the merged solves). |
| `prolongation_cell_updates` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Cell updates of prolongations; equal to the residual updates. |
| `residual_cell_updates` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Cell updates of residual evaluations, one per cell and nonterminal level visit. |
| `restriction_cell_updates` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Cell updates of restrictions; equal to the residual updates. |
| `smoothing_cell_updates` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Cell updates of all smoothing sweeps, point and block. |

### PhaseTiming

Accumulated time and work of one phase over all its calls.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `calls` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Number of finished spans of this phase. |
| `exclusive_s` | `number` | required | Wall seconds excluding nested phases; these add up to `accounted_exclusive_s`. |
| `inclusive_s` | `number` | required | Wall seconds including nested phases. Do not add these up. |
| `multigrid` | [MultigridWork](#multigridwork) or `null` | optional | Multilevel work of pressure_solve with the multigrid preconditioner; omitted otherwise. |
| `operator_applications` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Operator products: the compact pressure products plus the independent true-residual products of pressure_solve, and one (CG) or two (BiCGStab) per inner iteration of the implicit solves. |
| `preconditioner_applications` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Applications of the selected preconditioner. |
| `true_residual_checks` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Independent face-by-face residual recomputations of pressure_solve. |
| `work_units` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Attempted inner iterations: PCG for pressure_solve, the implicit correction solves for momentum_solve and turbulence_solve; zero for other phases. |
